description: NHFLOW semi-implicit step with the non-hydrostatic pressure (A 510 12, A 520 2, Basilisk-style coupled eta-phi system): Beji & Battjes bar (Benchmark nhflow_beji_battjes_bar), 1500 cells, 2 sigma layers, dt = 0.02 s, relaxation zones with B 95. 300 steps: the waves reach the bar.
covers: the bed-slope terms of the coupled system ([u grad z], w_b, hpg slopes)
nh_begin: face depths and advecting transport at t^{n+1/2}, second-order face depth
